supportedClaims: Two distinct executions of the same supplied two-qubit Hamiltonian agree on its fixed-hamming-weight=1 sector ground state
outOfScope: Independent derivation of the supplied Hamiltonian from molecular or material inputs
Cross-hardware, noisy, finite-shot, or physical-QPU reproducibility

checks.criterion: The two Result Packages have distinct package digests and Session event traces.
Both executions use byte-identical canonical request and Hamiltonian digests.
The two finite statevector VQE energies agree within the declared absolute tolerance.
The two normalized statevectors agree up to global phase at the declared one-minus-fidelity tolerance.
